messages:
Leah (Sales): Heads-up, the AcmeEnterprise POC ran a ramp test and started hitting 5xxs around minute 3 of the ramp. Can we triage?
Sam (Support): On it. Can you paste the request id or a sample timestamp?
Leah (Sales): request id: r-0e3c7a11, customer reported 503/504s. Happened during 1k rps sustained burst for ~90s.
Ravi (Eng): Looking at traces, we see a cluster of `ERR_BACKEND_OVERLOAD` in the runtime around the same time. Autoscaler logs show scale-up started but instances not ready before errors climbed.
Jo (SRE): autoscaler-bot, post the related events for that timeframe please.
autoscaler-bot: events for window 1978203300-1978203420:
- 1978203312 scale requested for pool:pooled-gpu (delta +4)
- 1978203338 instance launch start (i-09a3)
- 1978203376 instance ready but warmup not complete (runtime warm cache)
- 1978203390 healthcheck flapped 2/5 on i-09a3
- 1978203402 fallback routing triggered to burstpool (limited capacity)
Sam (Support): So autoscaler requested nodes but warmup and healthchecks delayed. That explains the 503s while new nodes boot and the pool wasn't big enough to absorb burst.
Ravi (Eng): Agree. Two issues: 1) scale latency (cloud spinup + runtime warmup) 2) routing/burst pool sizing. For enterprise POC we usually recommend a reserved burst buffer for demos: `burst_pool_size: 6` for this model at target seq length.
Leah (Sales): Can we do an emergency config tweak for the POC tenant? Customer is evaluating enterprise SLA. They want to re-run the ramp later today.
Jo (SRE): We can temporarily increase burst_pool_size and enable `prefill_kv_cache: true` on the config for the tenant. That reduces warmup time. Will require a quick restart of the serving group (no infra change).
Ravi (Eng): Also suggest changing autoscaler policy: lower `scale_up_cooldown` from 120s -> 30s and set `min_capacity` to sustain their baseline 200 rps. That avoids large delta requests at ramp.
Sam (Support): I'm going to attach the relevant log excerpt and a short reproduction guide for the customer. 
Sam (Support): log snippet:
```
[2026-11-12T15:22:11Z] request=r-0e3c7a11 status=502 backend=runtime ERR_BACKEND_OVERLOAD queue=5
[2026-11-12T15:22:12Z] autoscale: requested +4 for pool=pooled-gpu (reason=queue_depth)
[2026-11-12T15:22:45Z] instance i-09a3 health=unready warm_cache=false
[2026-11-12T15:22:58Z] fallback-route -> burstpool id=b-2 (capacity=3)
```
Leah (Sales): Customer asked about pricing impact if we increase burst_pool or min_capacity for the demo.
Ravi (Eng): For short-term demo: cost delta is minimal (~$X/hr per extra reserved GPU). We can give an estimate in the note to the AE. For long-term they'd move to Dedicated which is different pricing.
Jo (SRE): Action items:
- Sam: send reproduction steps + logs to Acme + ask them to re-run ramp at timestamp window 15:22-15:23 UTC.
- Ravi: patch tenant config (burst_pool_size->6, prefill_kv_cache=true) and tweak autoscaler cooldown to 30s, set min_capacity=2.
- Jo: monitor healthchecks during the next ramp and be on-call for 1 hour after re-run.
Sam (Support): I'll open a short customer-facing note with those changes and an estimated incremental cost.
Leah (Sales): Thanks team. One more: security questionnaire had a question about fallback routing and data residency — customer wants confirmation that fallback pools remain in the same region.
Ravi (Eng): Confirmed: routing policy keeps region affinity; fallback only occurs within the same region unless explicitly configured otherwise. I'll add a one-liner for the security answer.
Jo (SRE): I'll watch logs and add a temporary alert: `poc-spillover-5xx-rate` -> paged at 10m sustained 5xx rate > 1% during ramp.
Leah (Sales): Re-run scheduled for 18:00 UTC. Sam, can you ping when config is applied?
Sam (Support): Will ping here when done and drop the config diff.
Ravi (Eng): Config applied to tenant acme-poc: burst_pool_size 6; prefill_kv_cache true; autoscaler.scale_up_cooldown 30; autoscaler.min_capacity 2. Rolling restart started.
Sam (Support): Restart finished, dropping the diff in the thread: 
```
- burst_pool_size: 2
+ burst_pool_size: 6
- prefill_kv_cache: false
+ prefill_kv_cache: true
- autoscaler.scale_up_cooldown: 120
+ autoscaler.scale_up_cooldown: 30
- autoscaler.min_capacity: 0
+ autoscaler.min_capacity: 2
```
Jo (SRE): Alerts in place. Will watch the 18:00 run.
Leah (Sales): Great — I'll confirm with the customer and coordinate the re-run. If they still see 5xxs we'll escalate to a hotfix on the runtime path.
Ravi (Eng): FYI if we see repeated warmup issues we may temporarily route to a smaller-but-ready model variant to keep latency/SLOs (we discussed the fallback model option in the last call).
Sam (Support): Noted. Will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
